name: ListNodes

parameters.help_en:
A comma-separated list of resource group IDs. You must specify either this parameter or `QuotaId`.
Constraints:

The user ID of the request must match the user ID associated with the specified resource groups.

All specified resource groups must be of the same type.

All specified resource groups must be in the same VPC
parameters.help_zh:
指定资源组ID列表，按逗号分隔，和QuotaId参数二选一必填
约束：
需校验传入的ResourceGroupId的UserId和请求的UserId一致
传入的ResourceGroup列表类型需一致
传入的ResourceGroup列表现阶段记录的VPC需一致
